How to perform a Cable Wood Chop
candidates.description:
Set a cable pulley with a handle attachment to its highest position. Standing perpendicular to the cable, grab the handle with both hands and step away from the cable so there is tension on the cable. With arms straight, rotate your torso away from the cable and downwards, keeping both feet flat on the floor. Your torso should be doing most of the rotation, while your feet and hips stay relatively straight.

The cable woodchopper exercise is one of the best movements for targeting the obliques, strengthening the core, and improving athletic performance.

If you want better core strength, stronger abs, and more defined obliques, adding cable woodchoppers into your workout routine can help. This movement trains your body to resist and produce rotation, which carries over to sports performance, lifting, and everyday movement.

In this cable oblique woodchopper tutorial, you will learn

- How to target your obliques and core effectively
